body:
Collapse Cursor install mental model to: install marketplace plugin → run `/adlc-init` (detects CLI, runs `adlc init --harness cursor`, offers CI rails-guard wiring). Execute/document human cursor.com/marketplace publish checklist. Optional: thin alwaysApply rule + CLI statusLine snippet for live ticket. Depends on MCP (T65) and agents (T66) so the published listing is not misleading about missing surfaces.

=== DELIVERABLES ===
1. Rewrite `/adlc-init` + adlc-init skill as a single onboarding flow with explicit steps and failure messages when `adlc` missing.
2. Docs: preferred install is marketplace (+ published cursor.com link once submitted); scaffolder demoted to contributor-only.
3. Checklist file or docs section for cursor.com/marketplace/publish; record submission status in integration docs (submitted/pending/live URL).
4. Optional niceties (in-scope if cheap): alwaysApply thin "ADLC is installed" rule; docs snippet for Cursor CLI `statusLine` reading `.adlc/current-ticket.json`.
5. Matrix: installer/statusline cells updated honestly.

=== ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA ===
- AC1: `/adlc-init` instructs CLI detect → `adlc init --harness cursor` → CI template pointer without requiring `npx @adlc/cursor` for normal users. VERIFY: smoke string asserts + docs test.
- AC2: Marketing/docs install facts are marketplace-first and mention agents+MCP if those tickets completed. VERIFY: integration-facts test.
- AC3: Publish checklist exists; if not yet live on cursor.com, docs say so explicitly (no fake URL). VERIFY: docs review.
- AC4: Does not remove npm scaffolder (legacy retained). VERIFY: package bin still present.

=== OUT OF SCOPE ===
- VS Code Extension UI / status bar webview.
- Breaking removal of @adlc/cursor scaffolder.
- Changing CI rails-guard security semantics (may document private-repo fallback only).
=== P1 ===
Publication blocked on AC7 installed-Cursor MCP channel proof.


(Renumbered from T67 → T69 so main's T62/T63 fleet/hollow-test contracts stay intact for rails-guard.)
title: Cursor DX: /adlc-init one-flow onboarding + marketplace publish checklist execution
